rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for the recurring section of a song.

example.english: When the refrain comes in, everyone sings along.
example.traditional: 副歌一到，成班人就跟住唱。
example.jyutping: fu3 go1 jat1 dou3 sing4 baan1 jan4 zau6 gan1 zyu6 coeng3

rows.note: Use this for a person's habitual repeated catchphrase, complaint, or saying, rather than for a song section.

example.english: “I’ll deal with it when I have time” is his refrain; he says it about everything.
example.traditional: 「得閒先算」係佢嘅口頭禪，乜都咁講。
example.jyutping: dak1 haan4 sin1 syun3 hai6 keoi5 ge3 hau2 tau4 sim4 mat1 dou1 gam3 gong2
